lines.text: The psalm calls all the earth to make a joyful noise to God and sing the glory of His name.
The psalm invites everyone to see God's works, and says He turned the sea into dry land.
God rules forever by His power, and His eyes watch the nations, so the rebellious must not exalt themselves.
God tested His people and refined them like silver, and after fire and water He brought them into exile.
The psalmist cried out to God, knew He heard his prayer, and ended by asking Him to forgive the people.

wrong_details.wrong: asking Him to forgive the people
wrong_details.true: blessing God for His loving devotion
